referenceFunction.includedProcesses: The module calls the module "natural gas, burned in boiler atmospheric low-NOx non-modulating <100kW" which in turn includes fuel input from low pressure (CH) network, infrastructure (boiler), emissions, and electricity needed for operation. The module uses the average net efficiency for the type of boiler (estimated from literature). The heat distribution is not included.; Geography: Extrapolation from Switzerland to Europe (RER).
